title: A School Exchange
description: Four short recordings about a school exchange: an announcement, two students, a phone call and a talk.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · A school announcement
parts.intro: You will hear a teacher, Ms Taylor, talking about a school exchange.

script.speaker: Ms Taylor
script.text: Good morning, everyone. I have some exciting news about our school exchange.

script.speaker: Ms Taylor
script.text: This year, twelve students from our school will visit a school in Italy for ten days in October. In return, Italian students will come to stay with us in March.

script.speaker: Ms Taylor
script.text: To go, you must be between thirteen and fifteen years old, and you need a letter from your parents. Please give me the letter by the fifteenth of June.

script.speaker: Ms Taylor
script.text: The students will stay with local families, not in a hotel. Each student will have his or her own bedroom, but you will share the bathroom with the family.

script.speaker: Ms Taylor
script.text: The trip costs three hundred and fifty pounds. This includes the flight, the food and the school visits. It does not include pocket money, so bring some.

script.speaker: Ms Taylor
script.text: If you want more information, there will be a meeting in Room Twelve on Thursday at lunchtime. Parents are welcome too.

parts.title: Part 2 · Two students
parts.intro: You will hear two students, Linh and Tom, talking about the exchange.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Tom, did you see the notice about the exchange? Are you going to apply?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: I'm not sure. I really want to go, but I'm a bit nervous about staying with strangers.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: I understand, but it will be a great chance to practise Italian. We've been learning it for two years.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: That's true. My Italian is terrible, though. I only know how to order pizza!

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Ha! Me too. But my cousin went last year, and she says the families are very kind.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: What did she like best?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: The food, of course, and the school. The lessons start at eight and finish at one, so you have the whole afternoon free.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: That's much better than here! What about the weather in October?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Still warm, she said. But she took a warm jacket for the evenings.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: OK, you've convinced me. I'll ask my parents tonight. Will you apply too?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Yes, I've already got the letter, and my mum has signed it.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Then I'd better hurry!

parts.title: Part 3 · A phone call
parts.intro: You will hear Minh, an exchange student, calling his host mother, Mrs Rossi.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Hello, is that Mrs Rossi? This is Minh, from the exchange programme.

script.speaker: Mrs Rossi
script.text: Oh hello, Minh! I'm so glad you called. How was your flight?

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Well, that's why I'm calling. My flight is late, so I'll arrive at ten o'clock in the evening, not at six.

script.speaker: Mrs Rossi
script.text: Oh, that's no problem. My husband will meet you at the airport. He'll hold a sign with your name.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Thank you. Is it far from the airport to your house?

script.speaker: Mrs Rossi
script.text: About forty minutes by car. I'll keep your dinner warm. Do you eat fish?

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Yes, I love fish. But I don't eat meat very often.

script.speaker: Mrs Rossi
script.text: No problem, we have a lot of vegetarian food. Is there anything else I should know?

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: I have a small allergy to nuts, so please don't give me anything with nuts.

script.speaker: Mrs Rossi
script.text: Thanks for telling me. I'll write it down. Oh, and bring a coat, it's cold here in the evenings. Our daughter Giulia is excited to meet you. She's the same age as you.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: I'm excited too. See you on Friday.

parts.title: Part 4 · A student talk
parts.intro: You will hear a student, Mai, talking about an exchange she did last year.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Last year, I went on the school exchange to Spain, and it was the best two weeks of my life.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: My host family lived in a small town near the sea. At first, I was shy, and I didn't understand much because everybody spoke so fast. But my host sister, Carmen, helped me a lot.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Every morning, we walked to school together. The school is different from ours. The students call the teachers by their first names, and they have a long break at lunchtime, when everyone goes home to eat.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: My favourite day was Saturday. We went to the beach, and Carmen's grandfather taught me to cook paella. It was difficult, and I burned the rice!

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: The only bad thing was the homesickness. I missed my family in the second week. But I called them every night, and that helped.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Now Carmen is coming to stay with us this summer, and I can't wait. My advice? Go! You will learn more than you expect.
